name: healthstars-replication
title: Replication package for 'Stars Misaligned: Medicare Star Ratings And Exact Clustering' and its online appendix

manifest.name: MANIFEST.sha256
manifest.note: sha256 of every file in the package; verify with `sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256` from the package root

raw_inputs.note: raw public CMS downloads listed by package path, byte count, sha256 and source URL; the hospital program's inputs are included, the others are re-fetched from their URLs
